contentBlocks.body: map creates a new array by applying a callback to every item in the original array.

**Worked example.** map calls the callback once per element and stores each returned value at the corresponding position. Here 2 becomes 4, 5 becomes 10, and 8 becomes 16. The output has the same number of elements.
An arrow body with braces needs an explicit return. Without one, map fills the output with undefined values.

**Try a small change.** Change the callback to produce a label string. What stays the same about the output shape?

Then complete the independent check below without copying the example. Explain the boundary case in words before running it.
